note: Dollar pricing as DATA, not code — mirrors config/model-tiers.json's own rule (a table baked into code goes stale silently). This is a SEPARATE table from model-tiers.json on purpose: model-tiers.json classifies generic routing aliases (haiku/sonnet/opus/fable) for the spawn guards, which is a coarser grain than pricing needs (opus-5 and opus-5-5 route to the same tier but do not cost the same, and fable-5 vs fable-5-1 differ only in cache-read multiplier). Extend THIS file for a new model's price; extend model-tiers.json separately for its routing tier. $/MTok prices verified live from the Anthropic pricing page on 2026-09-23. Override without a release by writing a file of this shape to ~/.claude/agent-companion/state/model-pricing.json — merged by alias, same convention as model-tiers.json.
matchOrderNote: Entries are matched in the order written above, first match wins — put the more specific pattern (opus-5-5, fable-5-1) before the pattern it would otherwise also match (opus-5, fable-5). A negative lookahead on the generic entry keeps this from depending on iteration order alone.
unknownModelsExcludedNote: A model matching no entry here is EXCLUDED from every cost total and counted separately — unlike model-tiers.json's unknownIsPremium rule, there is no safe dollar figure to guess for an unpriced model, so this fails toward omission rather than toward a wrong number.
